title: Availability.openingHoursString
description: Hours when something is available. Syntax according to schema.org for opening hours. For example, if contact can be made between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. Monday to Saturday and between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. on Sunday, this will be coded as Mon-Sat 08:00-20:00, Sun 08:00-18:00.
